findings: 79/79 legacy DB03 fields have proposed target/derived mappings; 0 are formally runtime-verified.
Legacy group config defaults allowWaitlist=true and allowSelfLeave=true when absent/non-boolean; vNext parity fixes authored.
Legacy locked REMOVED membership blocks self rejoin but explicit admin re-add/move may revive it while preserving the lock; vNext parity fixes authored.
Legacy active_course_key is intentionally remodeled as a PostgreSQL partial unique index.
Legacy backed_class_id is intentionally remodeled as backed_delivery_id plus group-roster consumers; end-to-end consumer proof remains a later verification gate.
